_comment: GlyphSpek DEFAULT governed-terminal policy (shipped with the extension). This is the deny-by-default policy used by the in-IDE Governed Terminal when no glyphspek.policyPath is configured. HONESTY for the SOFT (governed-unsandboxed) boundary: the terminal is NOT a sandboxed worktree, so file_read/file_write/command here are advisory deny-by-default and are NOT physically enforced by an OS sandbox. EGRESS is the part the supervisor actually enforces: every network call from the terminal is forced through the supervisor-owned metadata-only proxy and decided against the supervisor's model-endpoint allowlist (NOT this file's `allow.network`). This run is always governed-unsandboxed and NEVER product-trusted.
